title: Read five runtime type probes
description: You can compare supported operations, rebinding, branch selection, and annotations through the supplied outputs.

steps.description: Each lambda delays one operation until the loop calls it inside try. The recording shows two TypeErrors and one repeated string.
risky applies multiplication by 2 to each supplied value. The number, string, and list succeed; the dictionary raises TypeError.
The two assignments bind x first to an integer and then to a string. The displayed type names follow those values.

steps.question: Which supplied categorize call reaches division?

steps.description: The two calls display 51 and 100.0. Both shown branches succeed for these numeric inputs.
The annotated add function receives two strings and displays xy. This call shows that these annotations alone add no runtime check.
